answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has achieved great improvements in translation quality, largely thanks to the introduction of Transformer models.
answer_1.outputs: translated sentences with vocabulary selection for improved inference latency

answer_2.quote: We evaluate translation quality using SacreBLEU and COMET.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations with two annotators on the subsets of newstest2020 and IDTS test sentences where outputs differ between NVS λ = 0.9 (0.99) and align k = 200. Professional bilingual annotators rate outputs of four systems concurrently in absolute numbers with increments of 0.2 from 1 (worst) to 6 (best).
answer_4.guideline: Professional bilingual annotators rate outputs of four systems concurrently in absolute numbers with increments of 0.2 from 1 (worst) to 6 (best).
